Review the generated task board and blocker rendering

Review complete — 2 critical issues (C-1: quantity needs quantity_type discriminator, C-2: SELL direction ambiguity unresolved) and 6 advisory items. Full review at services/research/review_p2001_claude.md. Schema can be LOCKED once C-1 and C-2 are fixed. P3-001 implementation blocked until then.

Signal consumer artifacts complete: signal_consumer.py, executor.py, symbol_parser.py. Dead-code bug fixed (minor version warning). Key decisions made: DSPy scope limited to persona programs only, training from FB-001 preference store with operator-only signal quality gate, output is prompt_bundle through REG-001 lifecycle, evaluation gate includes denial-rate regression check (optimized persona must not weaken OC-001 deny-first coverage).
